ActionsRunCount.name: ActionsRunCount
ActionsRunCount.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND createdAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
WITH count(run) AS runs,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled
RETURN runs, completed, succeeded, failed, cancelled,
       CASE WHEN completed = 0 THEN null
            ELSE round(100.0 * succeeded / completed, 1) END AS successRatePct

ActionsRecentRuns.name: ActionsRecentRuns
ActionsRecentRuns.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_WORKFLOW_RUN]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WHERE run.created_at >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND run.created_at < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(run.created_at) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
RETURN toInteger(run.id) AS runId, CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END AS workflow, run.display_title AS title,
       run.head_branch AS branch, run.event AS event, run.status AS status,
       run.conclusion AS conclusion, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt,
       run.actor AS actor, run.created_at AS createdAt,
       CASE WHEN run.status = 'completed' THEN duration.inSeconds(datetime(run.run_started_at), datetime(run.updated_at)).seconds ELSE null END AS runSeconds,
       duration.inSeconds(datetime(run.created_at), datetime(run.run_started_at)).seconds AS queueSeconds,
       run.html_url AS url
ORDER BY run.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

ActionsWorkflowSummary.name: ActionsWorkflowSummary
ActionsWorkflowSummary.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND createdAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
  AND status = 'completed'
WITH CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END AS workflow, run, duration.inSeconds(datetime(run.run_started_at), datetime(run.updated_at)).seconds AS runSeconds, duration.inSeconds(datetime(run.created_at), datetime(run.run_started_at)).seconds AS queueSeconds
WITH workflow, count(run) AS runs,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
     avg(runSeconds) AS avgRunSeconds, max(runSeconds) AS maxRunSeconds,
     avg(queueSeconds) AS avgQueueSeconds
RETURN workflow, runs, succeeded, failed, cancelled,
       round(100.0 * failed / runs, 1) AS failureRatePct,
       round(avgRunSeconds / 60.0, 1) AS avgRunMinutes,
       round(maxRunSeconds / 60.0, 1) AS longestRunMinutes,
       round(avgQueueSeconds, 0) AS avgQueueSeconds
ORDER BY failureRatePct DESC, runs DESC

ActionsBrokenMains.name: ActionsBrokenMains
ActionsBrokenMains.cypher:
MATCH (w:ActionsWatch)-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH w, run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 14}))
  AND branch = coalesce(w.branch, 'main')
  AND status = 'completed'
WITH w, CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END AS workflow, run
ORDER BY run.created_at DESC
WITH w, workflow, collect(run) AS runs
WITH w, workflow, runs[0] AS latest,
     [x IN runs WHERE x.conclusion = 'success'][0] AS lastGreen,
     size([x IN runs WHERE x.conclusion = 'failure']) AS failuresInWindow
WHERE false OR latest.conclusion <> 'success'
RETURN w.full_name AS repo, coalesce(w.branch, 'main') AS branch, workflow,
       latest.conclusion AS latestConclusion, latest.created_at AS latestAt,
       latest.display_title AS latestTitle, latest.actor AS latestActor, latest.html_url AS latestUrl,
       CASE WHEN lastGreen IS NULL THEN null ELSE lastGreen.created_at END AS lastGreenAt,
       failuresInWindow
ORDER BY CASE latest.conclusion WHEN 'failure' THEN 0 WHEN 'timed_out' THEN 1 WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, repo ASC, workflow ASC

ActionsBrokenPullRequests.name: ActionsBrokenPullRequests
ActionsBrokenPullRequests.cypher:
MATCH (w:ActionsWatch)-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH w, run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE ('embabel/embabel-agent' = '' OR w.full_name = 'embabel/embabel-agent')
  AND createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
  AND event = 'pull_request'
  AND status = 'completed'
WITH w, run.head_branch AS branch, CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END AS workflow, run
ORDER BY run.created_at DESC
WITH w, branch, workflow, collect(run)[0] AS latest
WHERE latest.conclusion = 'failure'
WITH w, branch, workflow, latest, latest.created_at AS failedAt
ORDER BY failedAt DESC
LIMIT 100
RETURN w.full_name AS repo, branch, workflow, latest.display_title AS title,
       coalesce(latest.pr_numbers, []) AS prNumbers, latest.actor AS actor,
       failedAt, toInteger(latest.id) AS runId, latest.html_url AS url
ORDER BY failedAt DESC

ActionsFailureThemes.name: ActionsFailureThemes
ActionsFailureThemes.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND createdAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
  AND conclusion = 'failure'
WITH run, createdAt ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 20
MATCH (run)-[:HAS_JOB]->(j:WorkflowJob)
WHERE j.conclusion = 'failure'
OPTIONAL MATCH (j)-[:HAS_ANNOTATION]->(a:CheckAnnotation)
WHERE a.annotation_level = 'failure'
WITH run, j, [m IN collect(DISTINCT a.message)[0..4] | substring(m, 0, 240)] AS errors,
     [i IN range(0, size(coalesce(j.step_names, [])) - 1) WHERE j.step_conclusions[i] = 'failure' | j.step_names[i]] AS failedSteps
WITH CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END + ' / ' + j.name + ' on ' + run.head_branch + ' (' + run.event + '): failed at step ' +
     CASE WHEN size(failedSteps) = 0 THEN 'unknown'
          ELSE reduce(s = '', x IN failedSteps | s + CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + x) END +
     CASE WHEN size(errors) = 0 THEN ''
          ELSE '. Errors: ' + reduce(s = '', e IN errors | s + CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE ' | ' END + e) END
     AS fact
RETURN themes(fact,
  'Group these CI job failures by underlying cause — the same step failing the same way across runs is one theme, however many workflows it hit. Name each theme by the cause, not the job.',
  5) AS themes

ActionsBriefing.name: ActionsBriefing
ActionsBriefing.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND createdAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
  AND status = 'completed'
WITH CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END AS workflow, run,
     duration.inSeconds(datetime(run.run_started_at), datetime(run.updated_at)).seconds AS runSeconds,
     duration.inSeconds(datetime(run.created_at), datetime(run.run_started_at)).seconds AS queueSeconds
WITH workflow, count(run) AS runs,
     sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
     round(avg(runSeconds) / 60.0, 1) AS avgMin, round(max(runSeconds) / 60.0, 1) AS maxMin,
     round(avg(queueSeconds), 0) AS avgQueue
WITH collect('Workflow "' + workflow + '": ' + toString(runs) + ' completed runs, of which ' +
             toString(failed) + ' failed (' + toString(round(100.0 * failed / runs, 1)) +
             '% failure rate); average run time ' + toString(avgMin) + ' min, longest ' +
             toString(maxMin) + ' min, average queue ' + toString(avgQueue) + ' s') AS summaryFacts
MATCH (r2:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(f:WorkflowRun)
WITH summaryFacts, f, f.created_at AS fCreatedAt
WHERE fCreatedAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' AND fCreatedAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(fCreatedAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
WITH summaryFacts, f, fCreatedAt, CASE WHEN f.conclusion = 'failure' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS failedFirst
ORDER BY failedFirst, fCreatedAt DESC
LIMIT 15
MATCH (f)-[:HAS_JOB]->(j:WorkflowJob)
WHERE j.conclusion = 'failure'
WITH summaryFacts,
     CASE WHEN f.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(f.path, '/')[1] ELSE f.name END + '" job "' + j.name AS failingJob,
     reduce(s = '', x IN [i IN range(0, size(coalesce(j.step_names, [])) - 1) WHERE j.step_conclusions[i] = 'failure' | j.step_names[i]] | s + CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + x) AS steps,
     count(*) AS n
WITH summaryFacts, collect('Among the failed runs opened, workflow "' + failingJob + '" failed ' + toString(n) +
                           ' time(s) at step ' + CASE WHEN steps = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE '"' + steps + '"' END) AS failureFacts
UNWIND summaryFacts + failureFacts AS fact
RETURN synthesize(fact,
  'You are briefing an engineering team at standup on their GitHub Actions CI over a recent window, using ONLY these facts. Read each fact carefully: "N completed runs, of which M failed" means M out of N, not all. In under 140 words: say whether CI is healthy, name the workflow with the worst failure rate and the one that takes longest, say what is failing most and at which step, and suggest the one thing to look at first. Cite the numbers. Never mention a workflow, job or step not listed. No preamble.'
) AS briefing

ActionsRunJobs.name: ActionsRunJobs
ActionsRunJobs.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE toInteger(run.id) = 0
MATCH (run)-[:HAS_JOB]->(j:WorkflowJob)
WITH j, CASE WHEN j.status = 'completed' THEN duration.inSeconds(datetime(j.started_at), datetime(j.completed_at)).seconds ELSE null END AS jobSeconds
RETURN toInteger(j.id) AS jobId, j.name AS job, toInteger(j.run_attempt) AS attempt,
       j.status AS status, j.conclusion AS conclusion,
       round(jobSeconds / 60.0, 1) AS runMinutes, jobSeconds,
       [i IN range(0, size(coalesce(j.step_names, [])) - 1) WHERE j.step_conclusions[i] = 'failure' | j.step_names[i]] AS failedSteps, size(coalesce(j.step_names, [])) AS steps,
       j.runner_name AS runner, j.started_at AS startedAt, j.html_url AS url
ORDER BY jobSeconds DESC

ActionsSlowestJobs.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt

MATCH (run)-[:HAS_JOB]->(j:WorkflowJob)

RETURN toInteger(j.id) AS jobId, j.name AS job, j.conclusion AS conclusion,

ActionsFailingSteps.name: ActionsFailingSteps
ActionsFailingSteps.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND createdAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 7}))
  AND conclusion = 'failure'
WITH run, createdAt ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 25
MATCH (run)-[:HAS_JOB]->(j:WorkflowJob)
WHERE j.conclusion = 'failure'
WITH run, j, [i IN range(0, size(coalesce(j.step_names, [])) - 1) WHERE j.step_conclusions[i] = 'failure' | j.step_names[i]] AS failedSteps
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(failedSteps) = 0 THEN ['(no failed step recorded)'] ELSE failedSteps END) AS step
WITH CASE WHEN run.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(run.path, '/')[1] ELSE run.name END AS workflow, j.name AS job, step, collect(DISTINCT run) AS runsHit, count(j) AS failures
RETURN workflow, job, step, failures, size(runsHit) AS runsAffected,
       [x IN runsHit[0..3] | x.html_url] AS exampleRuns
ORDER BY failures DESC, runsAffected DESC
LIMIT 20

ActionsFlakyJobs.name: ActionsFlakyJobs
ActionsFlakyJobs.cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WITH run, run.created_at AS createdAt, run.status AS status, run.conclusion AS conclusion, run.event AS event, run.head_branch AS branch, toInteger(run.run_attempt) AS attempt
WHERE createdAt >= '2026-09-16T17:58:06Z'
  AND createdAt < '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z'
  AND ('2026-09-16T17:58:06Z' <> '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' OR datetime(createdAt) >= datetime() - duration({days: 30}))
  AND attempt > 1 AND conclusion = 'success'
WITH run, createdAt ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 25
MATCH (run)-[:HAS_JOB]->(j:WorkflowJob)
WITH run, j.name AS job, collect(DISTINCT j.conclusion) AS conclusions
WHERE 'failure' IN conclusions AND 'success' IN conclusions
WITH job, collect(DISTINCT run) AS runsHit
RETURN job, size(runsHit) AS timesFlaked,
       [x IN runsHit | CASE WHEN x.path STARTS WITH 'dynamic/' THEN 'dynamic: ' + split(x.path, '/')[1] ELSE x.name END][0] AS workflow,
       [x IN runsHit[0..3] | x.html_url] AS exampleRuns
ORDER BY timesFlaked DESC, job ASC
